title: Stairway to Forgotten Dreams
description: A young woman in a purple spacesuit stands on a rusted spiral staircase inside a decaying structure, holding a flaming film reel. The walls are lined with glowing framed paintings while a beam of light streams down from above, illuminating floating embers and a giant mechanical vault door in the background.
prompt: A young woman with dark hair wearing a purple futuristic suit stands on a decaying spiral metal staircase, holding a burning film reel that emits flames. The scene is set inside a ruined concrete structure with broken walls, a giant circular vault door in the background, and numerous glowing framed paintings floating on the walls. Dramatic light beams shine down from above, surrounded by floating golden embers and rainbow light refractions, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
